page.overview:
Who is Annex Adminstrator?

The Annex Administrator signs people up to teach at the Adult Education Annex.

Homer, astounded that Lenny and Moe can teach a course at the Adult Education Annex, sought the opportunity to teach. In a meeting with the Annex Administrator, Homer is asked what his qualifications are to which he replied, "I can tell the difference between butter and 'I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!'" When challenged, Homer admits that he indeed cannot tell the difference between butter and "I Can't Believe it's Not Butter!" He is eventually offered a class, to teach the secrets of a successful marriage.
